facts.label: Trabalho novo
facts.sub: Use have to e has to para falar de deveres: You have to wear a badge. She has to meet the manager. Pergunte What time do I start work? e fale do emprego antigo no passado: I worked in a bank.

facts.label: Boas-vindas
facts.sub: Para receber alguém, diga Welcome to the team! A resposta comum é Thank you. I’m happy to be here. Também pergunte Is today your first day? para puxar conversa.

facts.label: Regras
facts.sub: Para falar de regras e deveres, use have to + verbo: You have to wear a badge. Com he, she e it, use has to: She has to meet the manager. Depois de to, use o verbo base.
